sources: recreation.gov campsite catalog for facility 10169583 (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20)

values.note: STANDARD NONELECTRIC $16 a night in every 2025-2028 rate season on recreation.gov (the USFS page still says 'Single Site: $15 per night'). Boat launch $3 per vessel.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10169583/rates (2026 seasons: StandardNonelectric $16) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10169583 ('Boat ramp available - $3 per vessel launch fee'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 10169583 (sites 02-21 STANDARD NONELECTRIC, Water Hookup No, Sewer Hookup No), read 2026-10-21

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/florida/recreation/hopkins-prairie-campground ('Tent and RV campsites: 21 sites') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10169583 ('There are only 21 sites at Hopkins Prairie'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/florida/recreation/hopkins-prairie-campground ('Vault toilets') + recreation.gov facility description ('Vault Toilets'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'Reservations are required. If there is availability, you can book same-day.' 14 nights in any rolling 30 days. Max 2 tents, 2 vehicles and 5 campers per site.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10169583 (notices: 'Reservations are required. If there is availability, you can book same-day.'; facility_rules maxStay 14 nights 'Rolling 30 Days'; 'All camping reservations must be made via Rec.gov') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/florida/recreation/hopkins-prairie-campground ('A maximum stay limit of 14 consecutive days is allowed in a 30-day period'), read 2026-10-21

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/florida/recreation/hopkins-prairie-campground ('Annual Senior Pass, Lifetime Senior Pass and Access Pass holders receive a 50% discount on the fee for a single campsite occupied by the passholder at ... Hopkins Prairie Campground'), read 2026-10-21

note: Hopkins Prairie is a seasonal prairie/marsh in Ocala National Forest; sites are in the surrounding forest and not on a permanent water body. Run by the concessionaire Naventure; reached by unmarked, unimproved forest roads, and low tree branches over the campground road may limit vehicle height (USFS, read 2026-10-21). --Claude
summary: Confirmed $16/night (rec.gov 2025-2028), no hookups. Added 21 sites, vault toilets, reservations required (same-day OK), 14 nights in 30, Senior/Access 50% stated for this campground. Not settled: season (USFS 'Open Year-round' vs 'open seasonally'), drinking water (rec.gov 'hand pump' vs USFS 'Potable water is not available'), max rig length (catalog has none).
flags: Phone 877-444-6777 is recreation.gov's reservation line, not the campground's; neither page publishes a campground number (the National Forests in Florida office on the USFS page is 850-523-8500).
Clearance caveat: 'low tree branches over the road may limit the height of vehicles entering the campground' (USFS); access is 'unmarked, unimproved roads' (rec.gov directions). No 4WD statement.
